originalBugReport.text:
[NegativeTotal] calculateTotal with discount code "OVER100" (150)

Bug Report: calculateTotal produced an unexpected result.

Engine: BUGGY (cart.fixture.js)
Discount applied: discount code "OVER100" (150)
Cart contents:
  - USB-C Hub x1 @ $49.99
  - Coffee Thermos x1 @ $34.99

Expected: a valid dollar amount >= $0.00
Received: 🔴 Result: $-42.49 (negative!)

Details: Result is -42.489999999999995 — total dropped below zero (no clamp applied)

Steps to reproduce:
1. Add items to the cart (see above)
2. Apply discount code "OVER100" (150)
3. Observe the cart total
